      "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Generate one NEW FIVE-PANEL COLOR MANHUA page of a monkey encounter, portrait 2:3, left-to-right reading. The attached image is ONLY the new character and ink/color reference, not a layout. Use precisely its GOLDEN monkey (top) and DARK BROWN monkey (bottom), their matte ochre/umber fills, broad black shapes, expressive narrow-muzzle faces, lean bodies and long tails. Dark's anatomical LEFT ear has one missing V in upper rim; RIGHT ear intact. They are ANIMAL monkeys, covered in fur, no garments/weapons, no wounds yet. Do NOT reuse the old dense watercolor page; no old page reference is attached.

SEQUENTIAL ART: clear authored staging, physical motion and differentiated acting. Confident variable ink contours, chunky sparse fur silhouette, very few interior hair marks, plain ivory-white negative space, matte color planes and brush-ink black shadows. Keep a little soft mineral wash on the ONE establishing backdrop to retain mythic ink setting; all dialogue backgrounds almost blank. No airbrushed gloss, decorative grain, miniature patterned leaves, scratch marks covering every surface, 3D doll faces or scenic picture-book rendering. White space has a deliberate role. This is a finished comic page, not a rough sketch and not a sheet.

LAYOUT five panels: top wide panel about25% height; middle row narrow left panel2 and broad right panel3 together ~30%; wide panel4 ~25%; wide finishing panel5 ~20%. White gutters; ink panel borders slightly varied but clean. Render no panel numbers.

PANEL1: bird's-eye oblique view down slope: golden has OVERSHOT a leap over a fallen log and plunged head/shoulders into a sparse small bush, both arms spread trying to catch himself, leaves caught on hair, startled slightly embarrassed expression, tail arcs upward behind him. Fallen log behind his hindfeet gives cause, front torso partly in the bush gives effect. Exactly a few large leaf shapes on bush. Distant rust sea-cliff silhouettes and pale blue sea at edge of panel, two simple trunks. No text. Do not depict confident log running; this is the failed landing.
PANEL2: golden's second jump lands cleanly on a chosen flat stone. Feet grip, bent knees, tail balances, head snapped toward downhill voice; alert eyebrows unlike panel1. Mostly white backdrop with two movement strokes. Jagged urgent OFF-PANEL balloon at upper edge, tail toward outside downhill: "Đừng xuống!"
PANEL3: dark monkey PERCHED on black tree branch ABOVE golden, dark upper LEFT, golden lower RIGHT. Dark has suspicious curiosity, only ONE eyebrow lifted, mouth not scowling; looks at newcomer. Golden looks UP, breath caught, listens then replies dryly with neutral small mouth. Background white and one light muted-green brush patch, no foliage texture. Balloon1 upper-left soft irregular rounded shape, clear tapered tail to DARK mouth: "Tiếng động trên ấy là gì?" Balloon2 lower-right smaller rounded, clear tail to GOLDEN mouth: "Đá vỡ." Make speaker assignment unmistakable. Dark left ear notch visible if frontal angle shows it.
PANEL4: medium close two-shot, DARK on left leans toward GOLDEN on right. DARK head tilted and lips open asking with interested skeptical face, NOT snarling. GOLDEN wipes WHITE stone dust from chest with right hand; half-lidded deadpan face from reference with one mouth corner slightly relaxed, contrasting to dark's questioning face. Anatomy crisp; fingers separated naturally, white dust just a few specks. Almost all background blank white. Balloon upper left tail to DARK mouth: "Ngươi ở đó à?" Balloon upper right tail to GOLDEN mouth: "Vừa ra khỏi đó." Each tail visibly reaches toward the speaking muzzle, not the other character or torso.
PANEL5: both suddenly pivot and RUN downhill after a distant off-panel alarm, DARK ahead LEFT, GOLDEN follows RIGHT. Three-quarter backs/side profiles, stretched running limbs, tail arcs, no repeated frontal crouching portraits. Few simple black tree trunks give direction, pale green distant wash fades to WHITE. No other figures or text.

LETTERING: exactly the FIVE quoted lines, each once, Vietnamese accents exact. Upright hand-ink comic PRINT, stable readable letterforms, no italic slant, no cursive, no cartoon wobble. Match medium dark lineweight to ink art. Compact balloons with modest padding; normal speech smooth but not identical computer ellipses, urgent warning angular; clear tails near actual speakers.
